{{#invoke:ShipModules|infobox}}<noinclude>
== Usage ==
Infobox for ship module articles.

The template is wired to structured stub data in [[Module:Data/ShipModules]].
Article-level parameters can override structured defaults later, once facts are
ready to be filled.

<pre>
{{Ship module infobox
 |name = Beam Laser
 |image =
 |module_class =
 |slot_type =
 |mount =
 |manufacturer =
 |availability =
 |engineering =
 |related_modules =
}}
</pre>

Empty parameters are hidden automatically.
